headline:
I don't just train models — *I ship them*,
to production and to the edge.
paragraphs: I'm an AI Software Engineer with 1.5+ years building and shipping real-time AI systems — not notebooks, but systems that run in production and on the edge.

At Lambda Theta (ODC), I support enterprise AI initiatives for Elm (KSA), including work on Nuha-LLM-based solutions for production NLP and automation. My core is Computer Vision — CNNs, Transformers, YOLO, EfficientViT — but I own the whole lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment via Docker, MLflow, and GitHub Actions.

My trajectory mirrors the field's: starting in real-time CV and edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson, moving into MLOps, and most recently into Agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration. I care about measurable trade-offs — swapping architectures to win precision and recall while spending fewer resources.

stats.label: From Jetson devices to GCP & DigitalOcean
